description: This file defines the TableValuedFunction class for invoking Spark SQL table-valued functions, including methods for range generation, explode variants, inline variants, JSON parsing, and logging from Python workers.

classes.name: TableValuedFunction
classes.description: Interface for invoking table-valued functions in Spark SQL, providing methods for range creation, explode variants, inline variants, JSON parsing, and worker logs.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame with a range of long integers from start to end with a specified step.

methods.name: explode
methods.description: Explodes an array or map column into multiple rows.

methods.name: explode_outer
methods.description: Explodes an array or map column into multiple rows, including nulls for empty or null collections.

methods.name: inline
methods.description: Explodes an array of structs into a table.

methods.name: inline_outer
methods.description: Explodes an array of structs into a table, including nulls for empty or null arrays.

methods.name: json_tuple
methods.description: Creates a new row for a JSON string column based on specified fields.

methods.name: posexplode
methods.description: Explodes an array or map with position indices.

methods.name: posexplode_outer
methods.description: Explodes an array or map with position indices, including nulls for empty or null collections.

methods.name: stack
methods.description: Separates multiple columns into rows, effectively transposing columns into rows.

methods.name: collations
methods.description: Retrieves all Spark SQL string collations.

methods.name: variant_explode
methods.description: Explodes a variant object or array into multiple rows.

methods.name: variant_explode_outer
methods.description: Explodes a variant object or array into multiple rows, including nulls.

methods.name: python_worker_logs
methods.description: Retrieves logs collected from Python workers.

methods._fn: Internal method to invoke a specific table-valued function by name with arguments.
